guards.what: PowerCmd.Apply's `applier` argument -- this unit diverges the OTHER way
guards.rationale: ONE MECHANISM ACROSS THIS BATCH (rule 3), recorded at every site: the sim's monster ports drop PowerCmd.Apply's `applier` argument. C# is `Apply<T>(choiceContext, target, amount, applier, cardSource)` (PowerCmd.cs:67) and passes `base.Creature` at DevotedSculptor.cs:50, which passes applier=**null** for the RitualPower; the sim's `PowerCmd.apply(hooks, target, power_cls, amount, applier=None)` (cmds.py:851-859) is called without it at devoted_sculptor.py:42, which passes applier=self. In C# a null applier additionally SKIPS the whole Hook.ModifyPowerAmountGiven pass (PowerCmd.cs:123-126) and changes the key FindExistingInstanceForStacking uses (PowerCmd.cs:78, :112). Same observable today, EXECUTED (`py audit/tools/monster_probes_b06.py applier`): the sim has exactly six listener definitions that can see the argument -- powers.py:1577/1582 (ViciousPower, gated `name != "vulnerable" or delta <= 0 or applier is not self.owner`, powers.py:1569), powers.py:3910-3915/3918 (_PossessPower, gated `applier is self.owner and name == self._stat_id and target.side == "player" and delta < 0`, powers.py:3892-3907), relics/ruined_helmet.py:53 (gated on `target is not self.player`, never on applier) and relics/unsettling_lamp.py:67 (gated `applier is not self.player or target is self.player`). None can distinguish `None` from the applying monster for a power this unit applies. Named trigger: porting any listener that reads `applier` positively (a monster-applier-sensitive relic), or porting PowerInstanceType so stacking is keyed by applier. Third-file citations (relics/*.py) not hashed here. Direction note: every other site in this batch DROPS an applier the game supplies; this one SUPPLIES an applier the game leaves null. The executed listener census above covers both directions -- none of the six listeners can distinguish, and RitualPower is applied to an enemy so `ruined_helmet`'s `target is self.player` gate and `unsettling_lamp`'s `applier is not self.player` gate both fail either way.
